name: speech-balloon.lua
title: Speech Balloon
description:
A speech or thought balloon pops in behind the text and auto-fits its width.
The tail travels anywhere around the outline. 2D only: 3D projection is forced off.
author: Mug

name: bounce-stream.lua
title: Bounce Stream
description:
Countless pandas and pigs bounce their way across the frame from left to
right, each entering at its own moment with its own height, speed and size.
author: Mug

name: fast-forward.lua
title: Fast Forward
description:
A fast-forward mark whose triangles light up left to right, over and over,
with your text alongside it.
author: Mug

name: star-backdrop.lua
title: Star Backdrop
description:
Gold stars tumble in to reveal the text with a glint,
drift softly, and then burst outward, taking the text with them.
author: Mug

name: flower-bloom.lua
title: Flower Bloom
description:
Flowers bloom in a random order, gently sway, and become the text.
In the outro they return to flowers and vanish together. Colors,
gradient, outline and shadow follow the inspector once the text is in.
author: Mug

name: loop-flyby-and-sparkle-reentry.lua
title: Loop Flyby and Sparkle Reentry
description:
Characters loop in from the right, exit left, then re-enter from the distance with
a sparkle before fading out to the left.
author: Mug
